title: Leandro Leviste passport cancellation not yet an option, says DOJ
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Cancelling the passport of Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste amid a standing arrest warrant from a Makati court is not yet an option, according to the Department of Justice (DOJ) on…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cancelling the passport of Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste amid a standing arrest warrant from a Makati court is not yet an option, according to the Department of Justice (DOJ) on Wednesday. DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez noted that Leviste, who has yet to return home, has not been convicted of a crime or declared a fugitive from justice by the court. These, he said, are among the grounds for passport cancellation under Republic Act No. 11983, or the new Philippine Passport Act.
